subject: Intro: Hosted API evaluation — scheduling a 30-min walkthrough
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Rebecca Green <rebecca@olive-analytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Thanks for signing up — quick 30-min Hosted API walkthrough

Hi Rebecca —

Thanks for signing up for the Hosted API sandbox. I’m Diego on the SDR team — congrats on getting access. Would you be up for a short 30-minute walkthrough this week so we can:
- confirm your evaluation goals (latency/cost targets)
- show a quick sandbox run and ask about any integration constraints
- get you set up with an agenda and next steps

Proposed windows (PT):
• Thu May 6 — 10:00–10:30 or 15:00–15:30
• Fri May 7 — 09:00–09:30 or 13:00–13:30

If those don’t work, tell me a couple times that do and I’ll loop in our PLG engineer. I’ve CC’d Marcus and Mina so we can match the right technical lead.

Thanks —
Diego
Diego Fernandez | SDR, Redwood Inference
Attachments: none

From: Rebecca Green <rebecca@olive-analytics.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wright <tom@olive-analytics.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks for signing up — quick 30-min Hosted API walkthrough

Hi Diego —

Thanks — appreciate the quick follow-up. Fri May 7 09:00–09:30 PT works best for our team. Tom (cc’d) will join. A few notes:
- We’ll be testing multi-tenant prompt routing and embeddings for search — interested in perf at 512 tokens.
- We’re in SF (PT) and prefer an engineer-led demo that can answer kernel/quantization questions.

Can you include a short agenda and a sandbox access link in the invite?

Best,
Rebecca Green
Eng Ops, Olive Analytics

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Rebecca Green <rebecca@olive-analytics.com>, Tom Wright <tom@olive-analytics.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks for signing up — quick 30-min Hosted API walkthrough

Hi Rebecca / Tom —

Great — confirming Fri May 7, 09:00–09:30 PT for a 30-minute technical walkthrough. I’ll be the PLG engineer on the call. Agenda attached (demo-agenda.pdf) and I’ve provisioned sandbox access — see the short invite below.

Sandbox access (stub): sandbox-invite.txt — contains read-only API key and sample curl calls. Please do not paste keys into public repos.

Agenda (high level):
1) 5 min — goals & current eval setup
2) 15 min — live Hosted API sandbox run (generation + embedding sample)
3) 5 min — perf/quantization Q&A
4) 5 min — next steps & rollout options (Dedicated / Private)

Calendar link: https://cal.redwood.com/book/mee-30min-abc123 (invite will show up on your calendar shortly).

Quick ask before the call: can you share an example prompt or dataset shape (approx tokens per request) so I can pre-load a sample?

See you Friday —
Mina Haddad | PLG Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: demo-agenda.pdf, sandbox-invite.txt

From: Rebecca Green <rebecca@olive-analytics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wright <tom@olive-analytics.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks for signing up — quick 30-min Hosted API walkthrough

Thanks Mina — that looks good. Attaching a quick sample prompt (inline below) and approximate payloads:
- Typical prompt length: 120–180 tokens
- Returned completion: ~450 tokens (summarization use-case)

Sample prompt: "Summarize the following customer conversation and extract any requested actions and dates."

Tom will be the main technical owner attending — he may ask about KV cache sizing.

See you Friday at 09:00 PT.

—Rebecca

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Rebecca Green <rebecca@olive-analytics.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-05T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Quick pre-demo checklist + optional prework

Hi Rebecca / Tom —

Appreciate you scheduling this. A couple quick pre-demo items to speed up the session:
- If possible, drop a sample of ~3 conversations (redacted) to the sandbox invite thread so Mina can pre-populate the KV cache.
- If you expect high concurrency, mention expected RPS during the call so we can show batching/latency tradeoffs.
- Optional: review the attached agenda (again) and flag any must-cover topics.

Grace (cc) will join on the backend side for commercial fit questions if the eval looks like a good match for Dedicated.

Looking forward —
Marcus Lin | Head of Developer Growth, Redwood Inference
Attachments: demo-agenda.pdf (copy)
